title: Group
description: An ordered set of variables: a battery, a codebook section, a module, a questionnaire form. One per line in metadata/groups.jsonl. Provisional: the spike should test whether one record type holds all of these (STANDARD.md §10).

kind.description: battery: items sharing a stem and response format. section: part of the codebook or questionnaire. module: a topical module fielded as a unit. form: everything on one questionnaire form or ballot. other: say what in note.

stem.description: Text shared by the members, verbatim, for batteries.

releases.description: Releases the group applies to. Omit when it applies to all.

members.description: Member variables, in questionnaire order when ordered is true.

parent.description: Id of an enclosing group, e.g. the section that contains a battery.

origin.description: publisher or upstream_package for groups the source defines; rule for derived groups (e.g. a battery inferred from a shared stem).
